rows.note: Use 嚟 as the all-purpose verb for moving toward the speaker or the person being addressed.

example.english: Come over and sit down first.
example.jyutping: nei5 gwo3 lei4 zo6 dai1 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use 到 when the focus is arriving at a destination rather than moving toward someone.

example.english: We come to the station at eight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 baat3 dim2 sin1 dou3 ce1 zaam6

rows.note: Use 出現 when something manifests or emerges rather than physically coming.

example.english: A new problem can come up suddenly and make everyone nervous.
example.traditional: 新問題突然出現，搞到大家都好緊張。
example.jyutping: san1 man6 tai4 dat6 jin4 ceot1 jin6 gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1

rows.note: Use 射精 for the explicit ejaculation sense, not for ordinary movement or arrival.

example.english: He said that to come is to reach orgasm.
example.traditional: 佢話男人射精就係達到高潮。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 naam4 jan4 se6 zing1 zau6 hai6 daat6 dou3 gou1 ciu4
